workout.warmup: 8-10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%). Then ramp the bench: 115 x 8, 145 x 5 before your first working set. Add band pull-aparts x 20 to wake the mid-back up before you load it.
workout.finisher: Skip it if you're at 65 min - four heavy lifts eat the clock. Otherwise 10 min incline walk.
workout.coach_note: First session back after 4 days off and the back is fully clear - this is your best shot at 175 on the bench. You've hit 175 for 5/5/4 twice now and stalled on set 4 both times, never from strength, always from accumulated fatigue. Fresh CNS today: go get 4x5 and the lift graduates. Two things I'm holding you to. (1) 60 lb shoulder press is not ready - you got 3 reps on it Jul 22. Own 55 for 4x6 first, then take a bonus set at 60 just to see the number. (2) Face pulls. You've skipped them two sessions running, and they're the single best insurance policy for the exact spot that tweaked last week. They're placed before arms so you don't forget again.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press [HEAVY]
exercises.note: Your ceiling lift. Ramp 115 x 8, 145 x 5, then 175. You've gotten 5/5/4 here twice - set 4 is the whole goal today. If set 3 comes in under 5 reps, drop set 4 to 165 and get 5 clean there. Any sharpness in the left mid-back, rack it and move on. No heroics on the first session back.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 55 lb - 4 x 6, then optional 5th set at 60 lb
exercises.note: 60 was too much on Jul 22 (only 3 reps). Own 55 for all four sets of 6 first. Setup trick for getting them up: sit with the DBs on your thighs and kick one knee at a time to drive each dumbbell to the shoulder - don't muscle them up from a dead hang, that's what's burning you on rep 1. If 55 x 4x6 is clean, add a 5th set at 60 and just see where you land.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row [HEAVY]
exercises.note: Your strongest lift. You got 6/6/6 at 165 on Jul 22 then dropped to 160 for set 4 - finish all four at 165 today and 170 is yours next session. Chest supported, controlled, no yanking with the low back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown [HEAVY]
exercises.note: You ran out of gas here Jul 22 and stopped at 3 sets. Being fresh should fix that - all 4 sets today. Neutral close grip (you used the wide bar Jul 18, so this is the rotation). Full stretch at the top, drive the elbows down to the ribs.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.note: NOT optional today. Third session in a row on the schedule and you've missed the last two. Elbows high and wide, pull to the forehead, pause a beat at the back. This is direct rhomboid and rotator cuff work - exactly the tissue that tweaked last week.

exercises.name: Arms Superset - EZ-Bar Curl + Rope Pushdown
exercises.detail: EZ-Bar Curl 45 lb x 10 + Rope Pushdown 80 lb x 12 - 2 rounds
exercises.note: Rotated off the hammer/incline curls you did Jul 22. Only 2 rounds - the heavy bench already cooked your triceps and the clock is tight. Elbows pinned on both movements.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Cable Crunch 66 lb x 12, Dead Bugs x 10/side, Side Plank 30 sec/side
exercises.note: Different circuit from Jul 22 (that was pallof press). Dead bugs and side plank keep the lower back safe. Cut to 1 round if you're past 65 min.
